title.narrative: Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP) Global Peace Index

description.narrative: The Global Peace Index (GPI) is a quantification of the absence of violence or the fear of violence to assess a nations level of peace. It measures a countrys level of Negative Peace using three domains of peacefulness: 1. The extent of Ongoing Domestic and International Conflict, 2. The level of Societal Safety and Security, 3. The degree of Militarisation.
